name: google_keep
description: List, search, or create notes in Google Keep. Call with action='list' for all notes, action='search' with a query to find notes by title (Keep's API only supports title search, not full text), or action='create' with a title and text to add a new note.

action.description: list: all notes. search: find notes by title match. create: add a new note (requires title and text).

query.description: Title search term. Required for action='search'. Note: Keep's API only matches against note titles, not body text.

text.description: Note body content. Required for action='create'.
